companyFieldUpdates.description: CoreSite operates American Tower's U.S. data-center platform, providing colocation, interconnection, cloud connectivity and hybrid-IT services across major U.S. markets. At June 30, 2026, American Tower held 71% and Stonepeak held 29% of the platform's common equity; Stonepeak also held all outstanding mandatory convertible preferred interests. On a fully converted basis, the parties disclosed expected economics of approximately 64% American Tower and 36% Stonepeak, but a completed conversion has not been publicly confirmed.
